attr.title: REDRIVER2
attr.desc: REDRIVER2 is an open-source reimplementation of Driver 2 for the PlayStation. You need your own copy of the game: copy the DRIVER2 folder from your disc into ports/redriver2/DRIVER2 before launching. Game data is not included.
attr.inst: Copy the DRIVER2 folder from your own Driver 2 disc into ports/redriver2/DRIVER2. The folder must contain FRONTEND.BIN. Then launch REDRIVER2 from the ports menu. Game data is not included with this port.
